English: We report the first case of spontaneous subcapsular hematoma of the liver revealing a COVID-19 infection in a 44-year-old woman with no underlying health condition history, a computerized tomography evaluation showed an aspect of lung ground-glass opacities, with moderate impairment estimated at about 20%.
Luganda: Twoleka embeera esooka ey’ekitaba ky’omusaayi wansi w’ekibumba okwoleka obulwadde bwa COVID-19 mu mukyala ow’emyaka 44 atalina byafaayo bya bulwadde bwonna bumusumbuwa, ebyava mu kutangaaza okukolebwa ne kompyuta byalaga embeera y’okuba ng’amawuggwe galimu obucaafu, n’okwonooneka okutali kwa maanyi nnyo okuteeberezebwa okuba ku bitundu 20%.
Yoruba: A ṣàgbékalẹ̀ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́ fún ẹmatómà ní àyíká ẹ̀dọ̀ tó tóbi, tó ṣàdédé wáyé ṣe àfihàn ààrùn COVID-19 lára arábìnrin ọmọ ọdún 44 tí ò ní ìtàn àìlera kankan tẹ́lẹ̀, àgbéyèwò tomágíráfì onímọ̀-ẹ̀rọ kọ̀m̀pútà fi abala gíràndì gílààsì ọ̀pásítì hàn, pẹ̀lú àìṣedáada díẹ̀ tí wọhn wòye pé á tó 20%.
Zulu: Sibika ukuvela kokuqala kwe-subcapsular hematoma yesibindi edalula ukutheleleka kwe-COVID-19 kowesifazane oneminyaka engu-44 ubudala ongenawo umlando wesimo sempilo esingaphansi, ukuhlolwa kwe-tomography ngekhompyutha kubonise isici sokungaboni kahle kwengilazi yamaphaphu, enokukhubazeka okumaphakathi ukulinganiselwa ku-20%.
Hausa: Mun ba da rahoton matsalar farko ta borin jinin kwatsam na hanta da ba ta daɗe ba tana bayyana kamuwa da COVID-19 a cikin wata mace mai shekaru 44 ba tare da wani tarihin mtsalar kiwon lafiya ba, ƙididdige bayanan hoto na kwamfuta ya nuna alamomi a huhu, tare da matsakaicin rauni, an kiyasta kusan kashi 20%.
Northern Sotho: Re bega ka bolwetši bja mathomo bja go kgahla ga madi a sebete ka gare ga kheposole go go lemogilwego ka sewelo bjo bo utollotšego phetetšo ya COVID-19 go mosadi wa mengwaga ye 44 yo a se nago histori ya bolwetši bjo šoro, tekolo ya thomokerafi ye e dirišago khomphutha e bontšhitše ntlha ya diširo tša galase ya lebatong tša maswafo, ka tšhitišo ya magareng ye e akanyetšwago go tekanyo ye e ka bago 20%.
Amharic: በ44 ዓመቷ ምንም አይነት የጤና ችግር ታሪክ በሌለባት ሴት ላይ ድንገተኛ የጉበት በከዳ ውስጥ የደም ፍስተ-መርጋት ክምችት ኮቪድ-19 ኢንፌክሽን መኖሩን ማሳየቱን እንደ መጀመሪያ ክስተት ሪፖርት አድርገናል፤ አንድ በኮምፒውተር የተሰራ ቶሞግራፊ ግምገማ ደግሞ ወደ 20% ገደማ በመጠነኛ እንከን የሚገመት በአሸዋ እንደተገረፈ መስታወት ደብዛዛ የሳንባ ገፅታ ያሳያል።

English: Reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction confirmed the diagnosis of COVID-19 infection.

Yoruba: Ète asọ àpapọ̀ ìyídà àdàkọ lílo ẹ̀wọ̀n ìṣesí, fìdí èsì àyèwò ìkárùn COVID-19 múlẹ̀.

Luganda: Mu kiseera kya nawookeera wa COVID-19, okuvaamu omusaayi nga tekuvudde ku kufuna buvune ku mubiri gamba ng’okuvaamu omusaayi mu binywa by’omu mubiri mu balwadde abatalina kizibu kigaana musaayi kukwata kaayinzanga okuba akabonero k’obulwadde bwa COVID-19.
Yoruba: Ní àsìkò àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn COVID-19, ẹ̀jẹ̀ sísun tí kìí ṣe látàrì ẹmatómà tó ṣàdédé wáyé lára àwọn aláìsàn tí ò léwu púpọ̀, lẹ̀ jẹ́ ìfarahàn COVID-19.
Zulu: Ngesikhathi sempathamhlaba i-COVID-19, ukopha okuvela ungalimalanga njengama-hematoma azenzakalelayo ezigulini ezingenakho ukujiya kwegazi kungaba ukubonakala kokutheleleka nge-COVID-19.

English: In a recent case in Algeria, doctors examined a woman who was experiencing pain and fever related to blood-pooling, also called hematoma, in her liver.
Luganda: Mu mbeera esembyeyo okubaawo mu Algeria, abasawo beekebejja omukyala eyalina obulumi n’omusujja ebyekuusa ku musaayi okukola ekitaba, oluusi ekiyitibwa ekitaba ky’omusaayi mu kibumba.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí kan tí ó ṣẹlẹ̀ ní Algeria, àwọn dókítà ṣe àyèwò fún arábìnrin kan tí ó ní ìgbónára àti ara dídùn, èyi tó fara pẹ́ ẹ̀jẹ̀ sísun tí wọ́n ń pè ní ẹmatómà, nínú ẹ̀dọ̀ rẹ̀.
Zulu: Okusanda kwenzeka e-Aljeriya, odokotela bahlole owesifazane owayezwa ubuhlungu nomkhuhlane ohlobene nokuhlangana kwegazi, okubizwa nangokuthi i-hematoma, esibindini sakhe.
Hausa: A wani lamari na baya-bayan nan a Aljeriya, likitoci sun duba wata mata da take fama da ciwo da zazzaɓi mai alaƙa da taruwar-jini, wanda ake kira borin-jini, a hantarta.
Northern Sotho: Go tiragalo ya bjale go la Algeria, dingaka di hlahlobile mosadi yo a bego a e kwa bohloko ebile a na le letadi tše di amanago le go rotha ga madi, go go tsebegago gape ka hemathoma, go sebete sa gagwe.
Amharic: በቅርቡ በአልጄሪያ በተፈጠረ ክስተት ሃኪሞች በጉበቷ ውስጥ የደም ፍስተ-መርጋት ክምችት ተብሎ ከሚጠራው የደም መከማቸት ጋር የተያያዘ ህመም እና ትኩሳት ያለባትን ሴት መርምረዋል።

English: Scans revealed that the woman had no signs of liver injury, but did have Covid-19, which the doctors believe could have been related to the bleeding.
Luganda: Okutangaaza kwalaga nti omukyala teyalina kabonero konna kalaga nti ekibumba kyalina obuvune, naye yalina Covid-19, abasawo gwe balowooza nti yalina akakwate ku kuvaamu omusaayi.
Yoruba: Àwọn àyẹ̀wò fi hàn pé obìnrin náà ò ní àmì èṣe kankan nínú ẹ̀dọ̀ rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n ó ní àrùn COVID-19, èyí tí àwọn dókítà gbà pé ó níí ṣe pẹ̀lú ẹ̀jẹ̀ tó ń yọ náà.
Zulu: Izikena ziveze ukuthi lo wesifazane ubengenazo izimpawu zokulimala esibindini, kodwa ubenayo i-Covid-19, odokotela abakholelwa ukuthi kungenzeka ihlobene nokopha kwakhe.
Hausa: Ɗaukar hoto ya nuna cewa matar ba ta da alamun raunin hanta, amma tana da cutar Covid-19, wanda likitocin suka yi imanin cewa yana da alaƙa da zubar jinin.
Northern Sotho: Disekena di utollotše gore mosadi o be a se na dika tše di laetšago kgobalo ya sebete, eupša a be a na le Covid-19, yeo dingaka di dumelago gore e ka be e be e amana le go tšwa madi.
Amharic: ቅኝቶቹ ሴቲቷ ምንም አይነት የጉበት ጉዳት ምልክት እንዳልነበራት ነገር ግን ኮቪድ-19 እንዳለባት አሳይተዋል፤  ሃኪሞቹም ይህ ከደም መፍሰሱ ጋር የተያያዘ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ያምናሉ።

English: Typically, liver hematoma may be caused by damage to the liver tissues or by tumours, but doctors couldn’t find any evidence of such issues.
Luganda: Ebiseera ebisinga, ekitaba ky’omusaayi mu kibumba kiyinza okuva ku buvune ku busuwa bw’ekibumba oba okulungula, naye abasawo tebalina kintu kyonna kye baalaba ekikakasa ebintu ng’ebyo.
Yoruba: Ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà, ẹmatómà lè wáyé ti àwọn tíṣù ẹ̀dọ̀ bá bàjẹ́ tàbí látàrí ìju ṣùgbọ́n àwọn dókítà ò rí èrí kankan fi lélẹ̀ fú irúfẹ́ èyí.
Zulu: Ngokuvamile, i-hematoma yesibindi ingase ibangelwe ukulimala kwezicubu zesibindi noma izimila, kodwa odokotela abakwazanga ukuthola ubufakazi bezinkinga ezinjalo.
Hausa: Yawanci, borin jini na hanta yana faruwa ne sanadiyyar lalacewar toskokin hanta ko ciwace-ciwace, amma likitoci ba su iya samun wata shaida na irin waɗannan matsaloli ba.
Northern Sotho: Ka tlwaelo, hemathoma ya sebete e ka hlolwa ke kgobatšo ya dithišu tša sebete goba ke dišo, eupša dingaka ga se tša hwetša bohlatse bofe goba bofe bja dintlha tšeo.
Amharic: በተለምዶ የጉበት የደም ፍስተ-መርጋት ክምችት በጉበት ህብረህዋሶች ጉዳት ወይም በእብጠቶች ሊከሰት ይችላል ነገር ግን ሃኪሞች እንደዚህ ዓይነት ጉዳዮችን የሚያሳይ ምንም ማስረጃ ማግኘት አልቻሉም።

English: They also drained the blood from the hematoma and checked to see if the woman was suffering from a bacterial infection, but results for those tests also came back negative.
Luganda: Baasika n’omusaayi okuva mu kitaba ky’omusaayi ne bakebera okulaba oba ng’omukyala yalina obulwadde obuleetebwa obuwuka, naye ebyava mu kukebera okwo nabyo byakomawo nga biraga nti obulwadde obwo tebuliimu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fa gbogbo ẹ̀jẹ ̀kúrò lára ẹmatómà náà láti ṣàyẹ̀wò bóyá obìnrin náà ní ààrùn kòkòrò àìfojúrí kań, èsì ìdánwò náà ní kò ní.
Zulu: Baphinde bakhipha igazi ku-hematoma babheka ukuthi lo wesifazane akanakho yini ukutheleleka ngamagciwane, kodwa imiphumela yalokho yabuya ingenayo.
Hausa: Sun kuma zubar da jinin da yake cikin borin jinin kuma sun duba ko matar tana fama da ciwon bakteriya, amma sakamakon gwajin da aka yi ma ya dawo mara kyau.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba gamotše madi go tšwa go hemathoma le go a lekola go bona ge e ba mosadi o be a na le phetetšo ya paktheria, eupša dipoelo tša diteko tšeo le tšona di boile di sa laetše seo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በደም ፍስተ-መርጋት ክምችት ውስጥ ያለውን ደም በማፍሰስ ሴቲቷ በባክቴሪያ እየተሰቃየች እንደሆነ ለማጣራት ሞክረዋል ነገር ግን የእነዚህም ምርመራዎች ውጤቶች አሉታዊ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል።

English: It was only when they noticed an abnormality on a CT-scan, which included the patient’s chest and lungs, that they began to suspect a Covid-19 infection.
Luganda: Baamala kulaba mbeera etali ya bulijjo ku CT-scan, omwali ekifuba ky’omulwadde n’amawuggwe, olwo ne batandika okuteebereza obulwadde bwa Covid-19.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí wọ́n ṣàkíyèsí àìtọ̀ nínú àyèwò aláwòrán CT, èyí tó jẹ́ ti àyà àti ẹ̀dọ̀ aláìsàn, ni wọn tó fura pé ó lè jẹ́ àrùn COVID-19.
Zulu: Kube yilapho bebona okungajwayelekile ku-CT-scan, ehlanganisa isifuba namaphaphu esiguli, lapho abaqale khona ukusola ukutheleleka nge-Covid-19.
Hausa: Sai kawai lokacin da suka lura da rashin daidaituwa a kan CT-scan, wanda ya haɗa da ƙirjin mara lafiya da huhu, suka fara zargin kamuwa da cutar ta Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: E bile ge ba lemoga selo sa go se tlwaelege go sekene sa CT, seo se akareditšego kgara le maswafo a molwetši, moo ba thomilego go belaela gore go na le phetetšo ya Covid-19.
Amharic: የታካሚዋን ደረት እና ሳንባ ባካተተው የሲቲ-ስካን ላይ ያልተለመደ ችግር ሲመለከቱ ብቻ ነው የኮቪድ-19 ኢንፌክሽንን መጠርጠር የጀመሩት።

English: A reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) test confirmed that she was Covid-19-positive.
Luganda: Okukebera endagabutonde okuzuula ekireeta obulwadde (RT-PCR) kwakakasa nti yalina Covid-19.
Yoruba: Ète asọ àpapọ̀ ìyídà àdàkọ lílo ẹ̀wọ̀n ìṣesí (RT-PCR), fìdí ẹ̀ múlẹ̀ pé arábìnrin náà ní COVID-19.
Zulu: Ukuhlolwa kwe-reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) kwaqinisekisa ukuthi wayene-Covid-19.
Hausa: Gwajin majina (RT-PCR) ya tabbatar da cewa tana da cutar Covid-19-tabbatacce.
Northern Sotho: Diteko tša Reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) di tiišeditše gore o be a na le phetetšo ya Covid-19.
Amharic: የቅልበሳ ቅጂ -ፖሊመሬዝ ሰንሰለት ምላሽ (ቅ.ቅ-ፖ.ሰ.ም) ምርመራ ኮቪድ-19-ፖዘቲቭ መሆኗን አረጋግጧል።

English: Once the doctors knew she was infected with the SARS-CoV-2 virus, they were able to quickly treat her.
Luganda: Abasawo bwe baamanya nti alina akawuka ka SARS-CoV-2, baasobola okumujjanjaba mu bwangu.
Yoruba: Wéré tì àwọn dókítà náà mọ̀ pé ó ti kó àrun SARS-CoV-2, wọ́n tètè ṣe àyèwò fun.
Zulu: Lapho odokotela sebazi ukuthi unegciwane le-SARS-CoV-2, bakwazi ukumelapha ngokushesha.
Hausa: Da zarar likitocin sun san cewa ta kamu da ƙwayar cutar SARS-CoV-2, sun sami damar yi mata magani da sauri.
Northern Sotho: Morago ga gore dingaka di lemoge gore o na le phetetšo ya baerase ya SARS-CoV-2, di ile tša kgona go mo alafa ka tšhoganetšo.
Amharic: ሃኪሞቹ በሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ቫይረስ መያዟን እንዳወቁ በፍጥነት ሊያክሟት ችለዋል።

English: They brought down her fever and sent her home after a week in hospital.
Luganda: Bakkakkanya omusujja gwe ne bamusindika addeyo ewaka oluvannyuma lwa wiiki emu mu ddwaliro.
Yoruba: Wọ́n mú ìgbònàra ẹ wá lẹ̀, wọ́n sì ní kó máa lọlé lẹ́yìn ọ̀sẹ̀ kan ní ilé ìwòsàn.
Zulu: Bamehlisela imfiva bamphindisela ekhaya ngemva kweviki esesibhedlela.
Hausa: Sun sauke zazzaɓinta sannan suka sallame ta koma gida bayan mako ɗaya a asibiti.
Northern Sotho: Di kgonne go okobatša letadi le go mo romela gae morago ga go fetša beke a le sepetlele.
Amharic: ትኩሳቷን አውርደው ከአንድ ሳምንት የሃኪም ቤት ቆይታ በኋላ ወደ ቤቷ ልከዋታል።

English: This case study adds to our knowledge of how Covid-19 infection can develop in the body.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwongera ku magezi gaffe ku ngeri obulwadde bwa Covid-19 gye buyinza okuyingira mu mubiri.
Yoruba: Àkànṣe ìwádìí yìí fi kún ìmọ̀ wa nípa bí àrùn COVID-19 ṣe lè gbòòrò si ní àgọ̀ ara.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lwengeza olwazini lwethu lokuthi ukutheleleka kwe-Covid-19 kungakhula kanjani emzimbeni.
Hausa: Wannan binciken yana ƙara wa iliminmu na yadda kamuwa da cutar Covid-19 zai iya tasowa a cikin jiki.
Northern Sotho: Pego ye ya tiragalo e tlaleletša tsebo ya rena mabapi le ka moo phetetšo ya Covid-19 e ka gakalago ka gona mmeleng.
Amharic: ይህ የክስተት ጥናታዊ ጽሁፍ የኮቪድ-19 ኢንፌክሽን በሰውነት ውስጥ እንዴት ሊዳብር እንደሚችል ያለንን ግንዛቤ ይጨምራል።

English: In the past, scientists have seen issues of hematoma and haemorrhaging (bleeding) in other organs, such as the heart, and in glands connected to the kidneys.
Luganda: Mu biseera ebiyise, bannassaayansi balabye embeera z’omusaayi okukola ekitaba awamu n’okuvaamu omusaayi mu bitundu by’omubiri ebirala, gamba ng’omutima n’ebitundu ebirala ebibeera ku nsigo.
Yoruba: Ní àtijọ́, àwọn onímọ sáyẹ́nsì maá ní ìṣòrò pẹ̀lú ẹ̀jẹ̀ sísun àti ẹ̀jẹ̀ dídì (ẹ̀jẹ̀ sísun) ní àwọn ẹ̀yà ara míràn, bíi ọkàn àti àwọn abala tó jẹ mọ́ kíndìnrín.
Zulu: Esikhathini esidlule, ososayensi baye babona izinkinga ze-hematoma nokopha (ukopha) kwezinye izitho, njengenhliziyo, nezindlala ezixhumene nezinso.
Hausa: A baya, masana kimiyya sun ga al’amurran da suka shafi borin jini da zubar jini a wasu gaɓoɓin, kamar zuciya da kuma curin ƙwayoyin halitta masu tsattsafo da sinadarai da suke da alaƙa da ƙoda.
Northern Sotho: Nakong ye e fetilego, ditsebi tša mahlale di lemogile ditiragalo tša hemathoma le go dutla madi (go tšwa madi) ka dithong tše dingwe, tše bjalo ka pelo, le go dithaka tše di amanago le dipshio.
Amharic: ቀደም ባሉት ጊዜያት ሳይንቲስቶች እንደ ልብ ባሉ ሌሎች የሰውነት ክፍሎች እና ከኩላሊት ጋር የተያያዙ እጢዎች ላይ የደም ፍስተ-መርጋት ክምችት እና ፍስተ ደም (የደም መፍሰስ) ጉዳዮችን አይተዋል።

English: This is the first time, however, that a potential link between Covid-19 and bleeding in the liver has been made.
Luganda: Guno gwe mulundi ogusoose wabula okukola enkolagana wakati wa Covid-19 n’okuvaamu omusaayi mu kibumba.
Yoruba: Ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ rè é tí àyè ìsopọ̀ tó nípọn máa wáyé láàrin COVID-19 àti ẹ̀jẹ̀ sísun nínú ẹ̀dọ̀ máa wáyé.
Zulu: Nokho, kungokokuqala ukuthi kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwe-Covid-19 nokopha esibindini.
Hausa: Wannan shi ne karon farko, duk da haka, da yiwuwar haɗin gwiwa tsakanin cutar Covid-19 da zubar jini a cikin hanta.
Northern Sotho: Se ke lekga la mathomo, le ge go le bjalo, moo go lemogilwego ka kgokagano ye e ka bago gona magareng ga Covid-19 le go tšwa madi sebeteng.
Amharic: በጉበት ውስጥ ደም መፍሰስ እና በኮቪድ-19 መካከል ግንኙነት ሊኖር እንደሚችል ሲታወቅ ግን ይህ የመጀመሪያው ነው።

English: It is important to track potential Covid-19 complications involving bleeding, especially because another common symptom of severe Covid-19 is blood-clotting.
Luganda: Kya mugaso okulondoola obuzibu obuyinza okuva mu Covid-19 omuli okuvaamu omusaayi, naddala olw’okuba ng’akabonero ka Covid-19 ali ku ddaala erya waggulu akalala akamanyiddwa ennyo gwe musaayi okwekwata.
Yoruba: Ohun tó ṣe pàtàkì ni láti ṣọ́ àwọn àìlera Covid-19 èyí tó je mọ́ ẹ̀jẹ̀ yíyọ, pàápàá jùlọ nítorí pé ààmì tó maa ń wáyé dáada fún COVID-19 tó wọra gidi ni ẹ̀jè dídí.
Zulu: Kubalulekile ukulandelela izinkinga ezingase zibe khona ze-Covid-19 ezibandakanya ukopha, ikakhulukazi ngoba olunye uphawu oluvamile lwe-Covid-19 enzima ukujiya kwegazi.
Hausa: Yana da matuƙar mahimmanci a bi diddigin matsalolin cutar Covid-19 da suka haɗa da zubar da jini, musamman saboda wata alama ta gama-gari ta Covid-19 mai tsanani wato toshewar jini.
Northern Sotho: Go bohlokwa go lemoga mathata ao a ka hlagago a Covid-19 ao a akaretšago go tšwa madi, kudukudu ka gore le lengwe la maswao a kotsi ao a tlwaelegilego a Covid-19 ke go kgahla ga madi.
Amharic: በተለይ ሌላው የተለመደው የኮቪድ-19 ምልክት የደም መርጋት ስለሆነ የደም መፍሰስን ሊያካትቱ የሚችሉ የኮቪድ-19 መወሳሰቦችን መከታተል አስፈላጊ ነው፤

English: Doctors sometimes give patients anti-clotting drugs as a precaution against blood-clotting, but this treatment would worsen bleeding in patients with hematoma.
Luganda: Abasawo oluusi bawa abalwadde eddagala eriremesa omusaayi okwekwata okubatangira omusaayi obuteekwata, naye enzijanjaba eno eyinza okusajjula okuvaamu omusaayi mu balwadde abalina ekitaba ky’omusaayi.
Yoruba: Àwọn dókítà a máa fún àwọn aláìsàn ní ògùn tó ń díwọ́ ẹ̀jẹ̀ dídì, ṣùgbọ́n ó lè jẹ́ kí ẹ̀jẹ̀ ísun ara ẹni tó ní ẹmatómà pọ̀ si.
Zulu: Ngezinye izikhathi odokotela banikeza iziguli izidakamizwa ezivimbela ukujiya kwegazi njengesinyathelo sokuzivikela ekuvaleni igazi, kodwa lokhu kwelashwa kungenza ukopha kube kubi kakhulu ezigulini ezine-hematoma.
Hausa: Likitoci a wasu lokuta suna ba marasa lafiya maganin daskarewa a matsayin kariya daga zubar jini, amma wannan maganin zai ƙara tsananta zubar jini a cikin masu fama da borin jini.
Northern Sotho: Dingaka gantši di fa balwetši diokobatši tša go thibela go kgahla ga madi go lwantšha go kgahla ga madi, eupša kalafo ye e ka gakatša go tšwa madi go balwetši bao ba nago le hemathoma.
Amharic: ሃኪሞች አንዳንድ ጊዜ ለታካሚዎች የደም መርጋትን ለመከላከል ጸረ-መርጋት መድሃኒቶችን ይሰጣሉ፣ ነገር ግን ይህ ህክምና የደም ፍስተ-መርጋት ክምችት ባለባቸው ታካሚዎች ላይ የደም መፍሰስን ያባብሳል።

English: The doctors note, however, that the link between Covid-19 and liver hematoma is still uncertain, and that it isn’t possible at this early stage to definitively attribute the cause of this woman’s liver bleed to Covid-19.
Luganda: Wabula abasawo bagamba nti, enkolagana wakati wa Covid-19 n’ekitaba ky’omusaayi mu kibumba tennamanyika, era nti tekisoboka mu kiseera kino eky’amangu okugamba nti omukyala ono okuvaamu omusaayi mu kibumba kyava ku Covid-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn dókítà fi lélẹ̀, síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, pé ìsòpọ̀ láàrin COVID-19 àti ẹmatómà ẹ̀dọ̀ kò ì hànde, àti pé kò ì tí ì ṣe é ṣe ní àsìkò láti fi òte le pé àrùn COVID-19 ló fa ẹ̀jẹ̀ sísun ní ẹ̀dọ̀ arábìnrin yìí.
Zulu: Odokotela bayaqaphela, nokho, ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwe-Covid-19 kanye ne-hematoma yesibindi akukaqinisekwa, nokuthi akunakwenzeka njengamanje ukuthi kuthiwe imbangela yokopha kwesibindi salona wesifazane yi-Covid-19.
Hausa: Likitocin sun lura, duk da haka, cewa alaƙar da take tsakanin Covid-19 da borin jinin hanta har yanzu ba shi da tabbas, kuma ba zai yiwu a wannan matakin farkon a alaƙanta ainihin dalilin zubar jinin hantar wannan mata da cutar Covid-19 ba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, dingaka di lemoga gore kamano magareng ga Covid-19 le hemathoma ya sebete ga se ya tšwa e tiišetšwa, le gore ga go kgonagale gore mo kgatong ye ya ka pejana go amanya lebaka la go tšwa madi ga sebete sa mosadi yo le Covid-19.
Amharic: ሃኪሞቹ ግን በኮቪድ-19 እና በጉበት ውስጥ የደም ፍስተ-መርጋት ክምችት መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት አሁንም እርግጠኛ አለመሆኑን እና በዚህ የጅማሬ ደረጃ የዚህች ሴት ጉበት የመድማት መንስኤው ኮቪድ-19 ነው ብሎ በእርግጠኝነት መደምደም እንደማይቻል አስተውለዋል።
